sloka: सर्वथा निश्चित अर्थो अयम् हनूमति हरि ईश्वरः ।निश्चित अर्थतरः च अपि हनूमान् कार्य साधने ॥४-४४-९॥
transliteration: sarvathā niścita artho ayam hanūmati hari īśvaraḥ ।niścita arthataraḥ ca api hanūmān kārya sādhane ॥4-44-9॥

translations.english: 'This monkey king, Sugriva has confidence in Hanuman that he will by all means accomplish the task.'
